equivalence_boundaries: Raw candidate_cells is a deterministic screening count, not a count of mathematically independent laws.
A global rotation or reflection of a galaxy image may not create a different candidate; only rotation/reflection-invariant amplitudes, phase differences, and absolute twists enter.
Phase is inert outside the log-periodic family and threshold is inert inside it; polarity duplicates are omitted because a fitted scalar coefficient absorbs sign.
Threshold, scale, and power cells that produce numerically identical components are one empirical equivalence class and may not be described as separate discoveries.
